text.name: lc_appNote
text.text: Appearance is saved on this computer and only affects your own menu.

text.name: lc_noFarm
text.text: Join a farm to use loans.

text.name: lc_help
text.text: Ctrl+B / Esc: close Tab or 1-5: tabs Up/Down: select Left/Right: adjust (Shift x10) Enter: sign

text.name: lc_help2
text.text: Ctrl+S: save game Ctrl+Q: quit to main menu Ctrl+X: quit to desktop (press twice to quit)

text.name: lc_nSaveFailed
text.text: The game could not be saved. Check log.txt and try again before quitting.

text.name: lc_nSaveWait
text.text: Still saving. Wait until the save has finished.

text.name: input_LC_SAVE_GAME
text.text: Loans And Credit menu: save game

text.name: input_LC_QUIT_MENU
text.text: Loans And Credit menu: quit to main menu

text.name: input_LC_QUIT_DESKTOP
text.text: Loans And Credit menu: quit to desktop

text.name: lc_statusBlocked
text.text: Blocked from new loans for %d more month(s).

text.name: lc_baseNote
text.text: The base-game loan is disabled. You can still repay an old one in Finances.

text.name: lc_h13
text.text: Old base-game loan of %AMOUNT% moved here

text.name: lc_nRolled
text.text: Your base-game loan of %AMOUNT% was transferred to Loans And Credit. Choose its term in the popup or in My Loans.

text.name: lc_nTermSet
text.text: Term set. Your monthly payment is now %AMOUNT%.

text.name: lc_h14
text.text: Moved loan term set to %LABEL%, %AMOUNT% per month

text.name: lc_popBody
text.text: Loans And Credit has paid off your base-game loan. You now owe the same amount here as a term loan. No money was added to or taken from your account. Choose how long you want to repay it.

text.name: lc_popLaterNote
text.text: Decide later keeps %s for now. Until you confirm, you can change it in My Loans.

text.name: lc_s_rollBaseLoan
text.text: Move existing base-game loans into this mod

text.name: lc_s_rollMonths
text.text: Term for a moved base-game loan

text.name: lc_desc1
text.text: Unsecured. Highest rate, limit set by your credit score.

text.name: lc_desc2
text.text: Secured by a vehicle you own. It can be repossessed on default.

text.name: lc_desc3
text.text: Secured by farmland you own. Lowest rate, longest terms.

text.name: lc_termInfo
text.text: Your limit grows with your credit score. Pay on time to raise it.

text.name: lc_noVehicles
text.text: You don't own any vehicles that can be pledged.

text.name: lc_hostOnly
text.text: Only the host can change these settings.

text.name: lc_s_lateFeePct
text.text: Late fee (% of the missed payment)

text.name: lc_s_missHit
text.text: Credit score lost per missed payment

text.name: lc_s_missesToDefault
text.text: Missed payments in a row before default

text.name: lc_s_blockMonths
text.text: No new loans after a default for

text.name: lc_s_scoreSpread
text.text: Rate change per 50 score points from 700

text.name: lc_s_paidOffGain
text.text: Score gained when a loan is paid off

text.name: lc_s_convertApr
text.text: Extra rate if collateral is sold

text.name: lc_nTaken
text.text: Loan approved: %AMOUNT% paid into your account.

text.name: lc_nMissed
text.text: Missed loan payment of %AMOUNT%! %LABEL% more before default.

text.name: lc_nDefault
text.text: Loan defaulted (%LABEL%). %AMOUNT% charged to your account.

text.name: lc_nPaidOff
text.text: Loan paid off (%LABEL%). Your credit score went up.

text.name: lc_nConverted
text.text: Collateral %LABEL% is gone. The loan is now unsecured at a higher rate.

text.name: lc_nBaseBlocked
text.text: The base-game loan is disabled. Use Loans And Credit (Ctrl+B).

text.name: lc_eScore
text.text: Your credit score is too low to borrow.

text.name: lc_eBlocked
text.text: You can't borrow after a recent default.

text.name: lc_eLimit
text.text: That amount is over your limit.

text.name: lc_eMoney
text.text: Not enough money in your account.

text.name: lc_eMaxLoans
text.text: You have the maximum number of loans.

text.name: lc_eHost
text.text: Only the host can change settings.
